imports.authors: Evelia R. Garcia Barroso and Arkadiusz Ploski
imports.title: An approach to plane algebroid branches
imports.location: Theorem 1.6 (Normalization Theorem), PDF page 7; Theorem 1.7, PDF page 8
imports.used_implication: A local irreducible plane curve has a primitive normalization parameter; orders along it compute intersection multiplicities. In characteristic zero a nonconstant x coordinate can be written x0+t^e after a formal change of parameter.

imports.authors: A. Hefez, J. H. O. Rodrigues and R. Salomao
imports.title: The Milnor number of plane branches with tame semigroups of values
imports.used_implication: For a primitive plane branch equation h and normalization parameter t, ord(h_p)=c(h)+ord(dx/dt). The paper explicitly states and proves this formula, attributing it to Gorenstein.
